_comment: Effective levels and dormancy against ../catalog.json. live lists Iron's live state per spell (max_level, enabled (default true), school (default the catalogued one)); a spell it omits is not registered. files are optional mapping files, as in ../mappings. Status names are loader-neutral: available, level_above_live_max, disabled_upstream, spell_missing, disabled_by_pack, retired, unsupported.
